name: Interrupted Loop Sensing Robot
hint: A timed or blocking operation shares a loop or conditional path with continuous robot sensing. While it runs, later sensor changes are not checked, so reactions can be delayed or missed.
instruction: Move continuous sensing into a separate parallel script when possible, or keep the sensing path short and nonblocking.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <@mBot obstacles ahead? :: sensing> then
@codeyA move forward at power (50) % for (1) secs :: motion
end
end
